mapper.select: SELECT distinct bm_storage_material_batch.material_id, bm_storage_material_batch.id as storage_material_batch_id, bm_storage_material_batch.material_batch_no, bm_storage_material_batch.hydration, bm_storage_material_batch.no_hydration_content, COALESCE(SUM(bm_storage_material.available_quantity), 0) AS quantity, bm_storage_material_batch.expired_date, bm_storage_material_batch.supplier, bm_storage_material_batch.producer, bm_storage_material_batch.factory_batch_no, bm_storage_material_batch.original_batch_no, bm_storage_material_batch.report_no, bm_storage_material_batch.licence_no FROM bm_storage_material_batch LEFT JOIN bm_storage_material ON bm_storage_material_batch.id = bm_storage_material.storage_material_batch_id AND bm_storage_material.is_deleted = 0 AND (bm_storage_material.sign_status IS NULL OR bm_storage_material.sign_status = 1) WHERE bm_storage_material_batch.expired_date > NOW() and bm_storage_material.id is not null and bm_storage_material.material_position_id is not null and bm_storage_material_batch.material_id = #{materialId} GROUP BY bm_storage_material_batch.id, bm_storage_material_batch.material_batch_no order by bm_storage_material_batch.material_batch_no
